title: Normalize feature scale without centering
description: A quick reference for the RMS statistic, learned gain, and pre-normalization terms used here.

terms.definition: A feature normalization using a stabilized root-mean-square denominator followed by learned gain.
The average of squared coordinates within one final-axis feature vector.
The multiplicative inverse of the stabilized square root used to rescale a feature vector.
The square root of a feature vector's average squared coordinate magnitude.
A trainable per-feature multiplier applied after the shared normalization factor.
A nonnegative term added to the mean square before the reciprocal square root.
The last tensor dimension normalized independently for every preceding coordinate tuple.
Positive input rescaling barely changes output when the signal's mean square dominates epsilon.
Normalization applied to the residual-stream input before an attention or feed-forward branch.
A per-example normalization that subtracts the feature mean before rescaling.
